projects.title: LankaCare
projects.subtitle: A connected healthcare ecosystem.
projects.shortDescription: Connecting citizens, hospitals and healthcare professionals through one centralized digital platform.
projects.problem: Healthcare journeys involve disconnected appointments, records and administrative workflows.
projects.solution: A centralized platform brings citizen-facing services and hospital operations into a shared digital ecosystem.
projects.challenges: Coordinating workflows across citizens, doctors, hospitals and staff requires clear access boundaries and consistent patient data.
projects.contribution: Full-stack project development spanning citizen-facing interfaces and backend healthcare workflows. The repository documents the implementation.
projects.improvements: Potential next steps: audit trails, stronger automated workflow coverage and deployment observability.

projects.title: ERCS
projects.subtitle: Clarity when every second counts.
projects.shortDescription: An emergency resource coordination system for incidents, response teams and resource allocation. Built as a two-member engineering project.
projects.problem: Emergency organizations need a common operational view to coordinate incidents, teams and scarce resources.
projects.solution: A centralized platform structures incident reporting, requests, allocations and operational monitoring.
projects.challenges: Keeping resource requests, available inventory and allocations consistent while supporting multiple operational workflows.
projects.contribution: Developed collaboratively in a two-member team for EC5207 DevOps Engineering, combining application development and delivery practices.
projects.improvements: Potential next steps: allocation conflict testing, notification workflows and operational observability.

projects.title: GramaLink LK
projects.subtitle: Public services, closer to people.
projects.shortDescription: A digital citizen and government service platform designed to improve interaction with local administrative services.
projects.problem: Citizens need more accessible ways to interact with local government and administrative services.
projects.solution: A digital service platform makes those interactions easier to organize and access.
projects.challenges: Translating administrative processes into understandable digital workflows while preserving clear roles and responsibilities.
projects.contribution: Client-server software project focused on coordination between citizens, Grama Niladhari officers and Divisional Secretariat officers. The repository describes its Java, JavaFX, TCP socket and PostgreSQL architecture.
projects.improvements: Potential next steps: usability validation, service status tracking and accessibility improvements.

projects.title: Personalized glucose forecasting
projects.subtitle: From time-series data to foresight.
projects.shortDescription: Exploring personalized glucose prediction approximately 30 minutes ahead, using continuous monitoring and contextual data.
projects.problem: Glucose levels change with personal and contextual factors. Forecasting requires careful handling of sequential data.
projects.solution: Explore preprocessing, engineered time-series features and regression models to estimate glucose around 30 minutes ahead.
projects.challenges: Avoiding temporal data leakage and assessing personalized predictions with meaningful model validation. No performance metrics are claimed here.
projects.contribution: Machine-learning project work covering data preparation, features, regression and evaluation.
projects.improvements: Potential next steps: compare patient-specific models, strengthen temporal validation and evaluate prediction uncertainty.
